title: Enclosed 3D printers in a makerspace
visible_text: How To Make a 3D Print Hexapod Robot
visual_facts: Several white enclosed 3D printers are arranged inside a large aluminum-frame shelving structure.
Four printers occupy the upper middle shelf and two larger printers sit on the lower shelf.
The printer doors are transparent, and filament tubes run upward from the machines.
Posters above the printers include the heading How To Make a 3D Print Hexapod Robot.
Two signs on the back wall read INNO Induction.
A black open-frame machine occupies the lower right bay.
spatial_relations: The printers are grouped in two rows on the left shelving unit.
Posters and small printed models sit above the upper row.
The black machine is in a separate frame to the right.
uncertainties: Smaller labels on individual printers are difficult to read.
The operating status of the machines is not clear.
